Subject: Orchard Systems: banking details + PO mapping for Redwood - onboarding

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Per our discussion, I'm attaching Orchard Systems' bank setup packet and a current W-9 so you can kick off vendor enrollment on your side.

Quick summary:
- Bank setup form: orchard_bank_setup_v2.pdf (includes routing/ACH + wire instructions)
- W-9: W9_OrchardSystems.pdf

We'd like to confirm the exact remittance string Redwood requires so our ERP can put the right PO and invoice references on outgoing payments. For our first invoice we expect a payment window around 2027-04-20. Can you confirm: do you need the full 10-digit PO, or a short prefix (e.g., RED-12345) as well? Also please let us know if you need a signed vendor agreement or tax certificate beyond the W-9.

Attaching both files to this message. Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations
Orchard Systems
liam.oconnor@orchardsystems.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard Systems: banking details + PO mapping for Redwood - onboarding

Hi Liam — thanks, received both attachments and starting the vendor setup. A couple of quick items we need to finalize on our side before we can schedule the first payment: 

1) ACH verification: we require either micro-deposit verification OR a bank letter with routing confirmation. Micro-deposits are faster; if you send the routing and account now we can kick that off.

2) Remittance string requirements: please include the full PO number and invoice number in the remittance narrative. Our AP system expects a single-line remittance that contains the PO in the format PO:##### (no spaces) and INV:YYYY-####. Example we will parse: "PO:123456INV:2027-0456". If you can map your ERP to emit that exact concatenation it will speed reconciliation.

3) Tax docs: W-9 present — thanks. If your legal entity name differs from the remittance name please flag that now.

I'll own the vendor record creation and set the pay terms to Net30 once bank verification completes. Marissa, can you please add Orchard to the next pay-run once verification is done? Rishi, FYI on the expected April 20 first payment.

If you prefer, here's a short intake link for bank details that auto-populates our vendor portal: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/orchard-bank-form

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
